name: RESET
notes: Tests primary and secondary slots for RAM and establishes SP; scans non-BIOS slots for page-1/page-2 AB/INIT cartridges and validated page-1 RBP1 payloads

name: CGTABL
notes: Points to the project-owned partial 8x8 boot font

name: VDP_DR
notes: MSX1 VDP data port

name: VDP_DW
notes: MSX1 VDP data port

name: RDSLT
notes: Reads primary or expanded slots on all four pages and restores the exact prior primary and secondary selections

name: WRSLT
notes: Writes primary or expanded slots on all four pages and restores the exact prior primary and secondary selections

name: CALSLT
notes: Calls page-1/page-2 targets with exact normal inputs in primary or expanded slots; page-0 targets switch through the page-3 CLPRIM helper and page-3 targets in another slot use a return frame in the target's page-3 RAM. Restores both selectors when the target returns

name: DCOMPR
notes: Needs flag and clobber conformance tests

name: ENASLT
notes: Supports primary and validated expanded slot IDs on all four pages and updates SLTTBL

name: IDBYT1
notes: International D-M-Y 60 Hz

name: IDBYT2
notes: International keyboard and BASIC identifiers

name: VERSION
notes: MSX1 generation identifier

name: CALLF
notes: Parses inline primary or expanded page-1/page-2 targets without changing their normal register inputs; page-0/page-3 targets follow the CALSLT paths

name: KEYINT
notes: Runs H.KEYI then scans keyboard rows and runs VBlank H.TIMI before updating STATFL and JIFFY

name: INIFNK
notes: Fills FNKSTR with the ten default function-key strings

name: DISSCR
notes: Updates TMS9918 register 1 through the shadowed WRTVDP path

name: ENASCR
notes: Updates TMS9918 register 1 through the shadowed WRTVDP path

name: WRTVDP
notes: Accepts B=data and C=register; updates MSX1 register shadows 0 through 7 atomically

name: RDVRM
notes: Reads the VRAM byte at HL through the data port after setting the 14-bit read pointer

name: WRTVRM
notes: Writes A to VRAM at HL through the data port after setting the 14-bit write pointer

name: SETRD
notes: Sets the 14-bit VRAM read pointer from HL with the control-port pair interrupt-atomic

name: SETWRT
notes: Sets the 14-bit VRAM write pointer from HL with the control-port pair interrupt-atomic

name: FILVRM
notes: Fills BC bytes at HL in VRAM with A; count and boundary behavior covered by the VRAM probe

name: LDIRMV
notes: Copies BC bytes from VRAM at HL to RAM at DE

name: LDIRVM
notes: Copies BC bytes from RAM at HL to VRAM at DE

name: CHGMOD
notes: Dispatches modes 0-3 and provides a guarded partial Screen 7 register handoff when a live standard SUB-ROM signature is found; modes 4-6/8 remain unsupported

name: CHGCLR
notes: Updates R7 from FORCLR/BDRCLR and recolors the Screen 1 color table; broader mode and register conformance remains pending

name: NMI
notes: Safe empty NMI return only

name: CLRSPR
notes: Initializes all 32 sprites: pattern table cleared

name: INITXT
notes: Initializes a fixed 40x24 text layout and the project font

name: INIT32
notes: Initializes a fixed 32x24 tile layout and the project font

name: INITGRP
notes: Initializes Graphics II registers and deterministic empty pattern/name/color tables

name: INIMLT
notes: Initializes deterministic Screen 3 tables and VDP state; broader register and timing conformance remains pending

name: SETTXT
notes: Switches the live VDP to 40-column text with the current work-area tables; updates SCRMOD/LINLEN/cursor without re-initializing the tables

name: SETT32
notes: Switches the live VDP to 32-column Screen 1 with the current work-area tables

name: SETGRP
notes: Switches the live VDP to Graphics II with the current work-area tables

name: SETMLT
notes: Programs Screen 3 VDP registers R0-R6 from the MLT work-area bases; broader conformance remains pending

name: CALPAT
notes: Returns the VRAM pattern address for a sprite: PATBAS plus A*8 (8x8) or (A&0FCh)*8 (16x16)

name: CALATR
notes: Returns the VRAM attribute address for a sprite: ATRBAS plus A*4

name: GSPSIZ
notes: Selects 8x8/16x16 sprites (A=0/1)
column8: and returns the byte size 8 or 32 with carry set for 16x16

name: GRPPRT
notes: Prints the character in A on the graphic screen at the cursor using the project font and FORCLR
column7: then advances the cursor by one 8-pixel cell; CR/LF move the cursor

name: GICINI
notes: Initializes PSG R0-R15 and the PLAY statement work area (QUEUES points to QUETAB
column8: voice static data and queues cleared)

name: WRTPSG
notes: Needs register-clobber tests

name: RDPSG
notes: Needs register-clobber tests

name: CHSNS
notes: Reports standard circular key-buffer availability with AF as the only changed register

name: CHGET
notes: Blocks for one buffered character and preserves BC/DE/HL; cursor and remaining lock-state behavior are pending

name: CHPUT
notes: Screen 0/1 text and Screen 2 glyph output plus BS/CR/LF/wrap/scroll; remaining control handling is pending

name: PINLIN
notes: Reads keyboard input into BUFFER until Return or Ctrl-STOP with mid-line editing (cursor left/right
column10: delete); HL returns BUFFER-1 and B the count

name: INLIN
notes: PINLIN with AUTFLG set; the buffer is edited the same way but nothing is echoed

name: QINLIN
notes: Prints a question mark and space then performs INLIN

name: BREAKX
notes: Tests the physical Ctrl-STOP matrix and returns carry when both keys are held with interrupts inhibited

name: ISCNTC
notes: Consumes a latched INTFLG break; carry and a cleared buffer on a break

name: CKCNTC
notes: Shares ISCNTC's break consumption

name: BEEP
notes: Short PSG channel-A tone

name: CLS
notes: Clears fixed Screen 0/1 name tables and homes the cursor

name: POSIT
notes: Stores one-based Screen 0/1 cursor coordinates without bounds checking

name: FNKSB
notes: Displays or erases the function keys according to CNSDFG

name: ERAFNK
notes: Clears CNSDFG and the bottom text line

name: DSPFNK
notes: Sets CNSDFG and renders the FNKSTR strings on the bottom line

name: TOTEXT
notes: Switches to the current text width and refreshes the function-key display

name: GTSTCK
notes: Cursor keys and joystick ports 1/2 return standard directions 0-8

name: GTTRIG
notes: Space and both buttons on joystick ports 1/2 return 00h/FFh and preserve non-AF registers

name: GTPAD
notes: Mouse selectors 12-19 implemented; touch panel light pen and explicit trackball detection remain pending

name: GTPDL
notes: Reads paddle 1-8 by firing the pin-8 trigger and measuring the one-shot low pulse on the PSG port-A pin; 0 with no paddle

name: RIGHTC
notes: Moves the cursor right; at the line end (LINLEN) it does not move

name: LEFTC
notes: Moves the cursor left; at column one it does not move

name: UPC
notes: Moves the cursor up; at the top row it does not move

name: TUPC
notes: Moves the cursor up; at the top row the text scrolls down one row

name: DOWNC
notes: Moves the cursor down; at the bottom row (CRTCNT) it does not move

name: TDOWNC
notes: Moves the cursor down; at the bottom row the text scrolls up one row

name: RSLREG
notes: Reads the primary-slot register while preserving all other registers

name: WSLREG
notes: Writes the primary-slot register while preserving all registers

name: RDVDP
notes: Reads and mirrors status register zero

name: SNSMAT
notes: Reads active-low matrix rows through the PPI and changes AF/C; broader hardware tests remain

name: PHYDIO
notes: Calls the H_PHYD hook when present; read-only-safe default reports no backend

name: FORMAT
notes: Calls the H_FORM hook when present; read-only-safe default reports no backend

name: ISFLIO
notes: Calls H_ISFL if present; read-only-safe default reports no active I/O

name: OUTDLP
notes: Calls the H_OUTD hook when present; read-only-safe default reports unsupported

name: GETVCP
notes: Returns a pointer to the active voice structure when available

name: GETVC2
notes: Returns a pointer into the voice control block by index and field offset

name: KILBUF
notes: Resets GETPNT and PUTPNT to the start of the standard 40-byte key buffer

name: EXTROM_COMPAT
notes: MSX1 compatibility return
